description: Miscellanous Hand Notice - Notice that Auction of right of reaping harvest of State Cinnamon Plantation in Pothukoladeniya, Kamburupitiya and Welipothahena D/S Division Kirinda-Puhulwella Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with the auction and sale of rights to reap harvest from state cinnamon plantations on specific parcels of land. It contains detailed land descriptions, boundaries, acreage measurements, and conditions related to land use and management. The content focuses entirely on land-related matters (state land auctions, land use restrictions, and agricultural rights), fitting squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
